pages.title: Control Seat Basics
pages.text: The Control Seat is the core of AeroIE. It transfers information, energy, and even fuel to peripherals on a subspace, turning the entire subspace into one controllable vessel.$(br2)Most AeroIE peripherals therefore work only while linked to a Control Seat on the same intact subspace: the connection must not cross a bearing, and neither block may have been detached from the physical assembly.

pages.title: Fun Facts
pages.text: 1. The Control Seat has about the same block hardness as stone, but is actually quite comfortable.$(br2)2. The Control Seat was the first block implemented after the AeroIE project—then named vsie—was created.
3. The Control Seat model was created by Automatic Service Network. Many thanks to them.
